svg.title: H₂: 에너지와 오차를 함께 읽기
svg.desc: 19 author-reported H2 dissociation results from a CPU simulator. VQE energies are compared with direct diagonalization of the same STO-3G Hamiltonian, in hartree. The reported absolute-error column is converted from millihartree to microhartree.
svg.metadata: {"data": "https://borealisdata.ca/api/access/datafile/1022680?format=original", "dataset": "https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/UAKARI", "licence": "CC0-1.0", "type": "redraw of author-reported CPU-simulator data", "reference": "direct diagonalization of the same STO-3G Hamiltonian"}
svg.text: H₂: 겹치는 에너지 곡선, 따로 읽어야 할 오차
Borealis V6 공개 CPU 계산 결과 19점 재도표
